questions.question: What does overlap mean when splitting a document into chunks?
questions.expected_answer: Overlap is the number of words shared by neighboring chunk windows.

questions.question: How is Recall@K calculated?
questions.expected_answer: Divide the number of relevant documents in the first K retrieved documents by the total number of relevant documents for the question.

questions.question: Which tools create embeddings and search vectors for dense retrieval?
questions.expected_answer: A sentence-transformers model creates embeddings and FAISS searches the vectors.

questions.question: Why keep a parent document ID on each chunk, and how are duplicate chunk hits handled in evaluation?
questions.expected_answer: The parent ID links each chunk to its source document. Hits from the same document are collapsed so document-level metrics count it once.
